text:
Alex CSM: Heads-up — Galileo Labs asked for a regional allowlist + temporary throttle bump for an EU pilot starting Tue morning. They expect traffic spikes during demos.

Priya Onboarding: Do we have the customer renewal window/health flagged? any churn risk if perf is bad?

Alex CSM: Renewal in 6 weeks, customer on a small reserved plan. This pilot is high-visibility — if demos fail they may pause expansion. Need this to be smooth.

Ravi NetEng: Can you paste the CIDRs and exact endpoints they hit? also do they require a TLS peering or just IP-level allowlist?

Alex CSM: They want TLS peering + header allowlist for app-origin header. CIDRs below and endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Proposed temporary qps bump from 100 -> 500, burst ok for 10m windows, auto-revoke after the pilot.

Alex CSM: ```
customer: galileo.ai
cidrs: [203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/28]
region: eu-west-1
endpoints: ["/v1/generate", "/v1/embeddings"]
requested_qps: 500
auto_revoke: 2026-04-01T00:00Z
header_whitelist: ["x-galileo-origin"]
peering: tls-required
```

Ravi NetEng: Thanks. I'll schedule the TLS handshake and check that our egress IPs map to those CIDRs. @infra-bot can you open an infra ticket for TLS peering + temporary rate rule? include auto-revoke policy.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-5421 — "galileo: eu TLS peering + temp qps bump". Provision ETA: 24h. Config snippet attached to ticket. :white_check_mark:

Sam AE: Quick note — legal flagged data residency questions. Galileo asked for EU-only processing. Can we confirm model routing will stay in eu-west-1 during the pilot?

Ravi NetEng: We'll pin routing to eu-west-1 for the pilot and add routing policy in the request. Need eng-runtime to confirm model variant availability in eu region but should be fine for the models they use.

Priya Onboarding: Also request enablement: a short runbook for the Galileo demo team (who to contact, expected failure modes, rollback). I'll draft and share.

Alex CSM: Awesome. Action items: Ravi -> TLS peering + egress CIDR map (ETA Mon EOD). infra-bot -> ticket + auto-revoke. Priya -> runbook and demo pre-check checklist. Sam -> confirm legal/residency OK. I'll notify the customer we have a provisioning ticket and expected ETA. :pray:

Ravi NetEng: One more — if we see sustained qps > 400 for 30m, do we want automated alert + temporary fallback to a lower-cost variant? propose alert to oncall + auto-fallback to 250 qps.

Alex CSM: Yes please. Add alert to INFRA-5421 and set auto-fallback policy to 250 qps.

infra-bot: INFRA-5421 updated: alert rule added, auto-fallback configured (250 qps), auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-01T00:00Z.

Sam AE: I'll update the customer playbook to note the auto-fallback and the rollback window.

Priya Onboarding: I'll post the runbook draft here when ready.

Alex CSM: Thanks team — can we have the TLS cert check + ticket updates by EOD Mon? Customer demo is Tue 09:00 CET. :rocket:
